findings.text: 适合把图像、音频和视频分阶段组合的创作者，交付可编辑工作流及媒体资产。
ABI定义节点契约，导出器形成可执行图，服务器调用Python插件并把资产统一落为文件引用。
核查根项目定位、ABI导出及Web通用runner，不代表完整审计云端部署、每个插件或供应商。
根项目是可自托管媒体平台，并含MCP、DSH等独立适配包；根组件不应误称单个DSH注册插件。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次使用 | 镜像、依赖和插件下载 | 部署、凭据和卷配置 | 安装耗时未知 |
| 持续使用 | 供应商API、GPU和存储 | 选模型及人工审核媒体 | 云端费用和同任务用量未核实 |
| 失败恢复 | 远端任务可能继续计费 | 对账、恢复文件与选择性重跑 | 取消不保证远端撤销 |
| 退出迁移 | 备份及传输文件 | 导出图和凭据清理 | 跨工具完整迁移未测 |

作者在README给出示例服务额度，本文不将该声明作为当前可得价格或预算估值。建议已有多阶段制作任务者先在本地副本限制插件范围，若只是单次生成、不能维护持久卷或无法核清取消后的费用，继续用现有供应商界面。
已有多阶段媒体任务者可在本地副本先试一个slot和最少插件，限制账户额度并记录远端任务状态；若单次生成已足够，或不能承担持久卷和失败对账，继续现有供应商界面。[Q03](#research-q03)

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 替换实现 | ABI与pluginId分离 | 各模型语义和质量等价 |
| 统一产物 | 执行后转换文件引用 | 跨工具完整迁移 |
| 工作效率 | 可减少手工串联的机制 | 合格任务节时与费用 |

执行器将能力契约、供应商入口、资产存储分离。输出统一转换为file_key引用，避免每个插件自行实现应用层文件管理；runner把stderr进度和诊断分开，stdout保留给单个JSON响应，有助于定位长任务卡在哪一步。

复用需要同时维护ABI、SDK生成类型、插件methodsByNodeSlot和画布节点的一致性。通用Python执行仍继承宿主权限与配置凭据，不是沙箱。其可迁移价值在接口和诊断协议，而非把任意Python插件当成可靠能力。
将材料、能力与供应商分开，使周围工作流有机会在替换插件后继续使用，并统一资产落位；属于多模态工作流集成贡献，未证首创。[Q01](#research-q01) [Q04](#research-q04)
合法图不代表外部任务可成功或可撤销；本地取消未证明远端终止，重复重跑可能增加费用。[Q02](#research-q02)
在slot选择中加入同输入的凭据、报价与恢复能力预检，检验是否降低配置失败和重复账单；尚未实现或验证。[Q05](#research-q05)

technical.rationale: Q01、Q02显示相对供应商直连，契约与图分离有实质增量，novelty/mechanism取50%；接口可迁移50%，组合简化50%，未证明强于直接节点平台或有新算法。

business.rationale: Q01、Q03说明流程组织、可编辑交付和跨技能入口分别50%；成本只有可能减少手工串联25%，无真实ROI。

recommendation.reason: 有多阶段图像、音频与视频任务的创作者可先用一个本地工作流试做。相比在供应商网页间搬运文件，它用共同节点契约保留图结构并统一媒体产物。若配置与失败对账超过文件整理收益，或只需一次生成，就退回现有供应商界面。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) README83-109给出连续素材复用和多阶段任务，比泛用途50%更具体取75%；独立需求证据不足100%。

advantage.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)与[Q02](#research-q02) ABI和统一执行支持超入口便利的50%；无同任务结果且远端恢复限制，不取75%。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) exporter、execute和runner覆盖核心链路，比声明25%充分，取50%；未运行不取75%。

cost.rationale: [Q03](#research-q03)部署与恢复负担可识别且本地文件可保留，高于25%；配置和账单复核明显，取50%不取75%。

| | Every output stays on the canvas as a material: branch from a generated image, feed a transcript into the next step, or swap the model behind one node and keep the rest of the workflow. ## How To Start There are three ways to use TongFlow, all sharing the same open-source core: **TongFlow Cloud** (the desktop app or [app.tongflow.com](https://app.tongflow.com) in a browser), **self-host** ([from source](#run-from-source) or [with Docker](#run-with-docker)), or **build with an agent** (the [`tongflow` npm package](packages/tongflow/README.md) or TongFlow [inside Claude Code, any MCP client or dsh](#use-it-inside-an-agent)). The cloud studio also runs in any modern browser. ### Step 1 — Install the desktop app Download the installer for your platform, install it, and open it. - **macOS (Universal — Apple Silicon & Intel):** [TongFlow-mac-universal.dmg](https://github.com/tong-io/tongflow/releases/latest/download/TongFlow-mac-universal.dmg) - **Windows:** [TongFlow-win-x64.msi](https://github.com/tong-io/tongflow/releases/latest/download/TongFlow-win-x64.msi) All builds are on the [Releases](https://github.com/tong-io/tongflow/releases/latest) page. > **macOS:** the builds are not yet notarized with Apple, so Gatekeeper will block the first launch ("TongFlow is damaged and can't be opened"). After moving the app to Applications, clear the quarantine flag once and it opens normally: > > ```bash > xattr -cr /Applications/TongFlow.app > ``` > > Download from this page directly — installers passed through chat apps (e.g. WeChat) may be renamed or re-flagged. ### Step 2 — Sign in and create Sign in with Google or WeChat and start creating — the cloud studio manages plugins and execution for you. > **Prefer a fully local, account-free TongFlow?** That's what self-hosting is for — see [Run from source](#run-from-source) or [Run with Docker](#run-with-docker), then follow [Self-host setup](#self-host-setup-plugins--credentials). (The desktop app up to v0.1.13 bundled this local runtime; those installers remain on the [Releases](https://github.com/tong-io/tongflow/releases) page.) ## Modality-First A modality is a form of information: text, image, audio, video, 3D, document, URL. TongFlow makes these the building blocks of a workflow. Decide what you want to do with them, then choose the model for the job. Every step is three separate decisions: | | Question | Examples | | :-- | :-- | :-- | | **Material** | What do you have? | A document, a photo, a recording, an idea. | | **Capability** | What could it become? | Understand, generate, transform, combine or split. | | **Implementation** | What should run it? | A compatible plugin and the model it provides. | - **Every result is a new beginning.** Materials have their own nodes. An uploaded image and a generated image can both feed the next compatible operation. Branch out from a result instead of starting over. - **Choose a capability, then a model.** A workflow records what a step does separately from the plugin that runs it. Switch compatible implementations while keeping the surrounding structure. - **Four operations.** Add, transform, combine, split & batch. Understanding, generating and processing fit into the same system; generation is one kind of operation. - **A shared structure for people and agents.** The canvas, exporter and agent tools use the same node registry. Build visually or through the `tongflow` package; inside Claude Code, an MCP client or dsh, an agent creates workflows you can open, edit and run again. - **Open ecosystem.** The ABI defines each capability's input/output contract independent of who implements it.
